content: Standard .NET desktop self-update pattern: check GitHub Releases API (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest) for newer tag_name vs running assembly version, prompt user, download asset, then use a separate helper process/rename trick to replace the locked running exe and relaunch. Libraries exist (AutoUpdater.NET, Velopack) but for a single self-contained portable exe, a small custom implementation is common and lower-risk than adopting a full installer framework.
